title: FTC Targets Edmodo for Unlawful Use of Children’s Data and Delegating Compliance to Schools

behaviors.text: Edmodo, an education technology provider, violated the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act Rule (COPPA Rule) by collecting and using children's personal data for [person] purposes without parental consent, according to the FTC.
The company outsourced its compliance responsibilities to schools, thereby making them "solely" responsible for COPPA compliance without adequate [person].
Edmodo is facing a proposed order prohibiting such practices, marking a precedent in the ed tech industry.
